products.name: Automation Anywhere
products.note: Intelligent automation platform; AI-powered bots; control room governance; credential vault

profile_text.body:
Automation Anywhere describes itself as a provider of agentic process automation, combining AI, robotic process automation, and broader automation capabilities into a platform intended for enterprise mission-critical processes. Its core offering is an intelligent automation platform that includes AI-powered bots, a control room for governance, and a credential vault. The platform centers on what the company calls the Mozart Orchestrator, which is designed to coordinate AI agents, deterministic automations, and human workers within a single system.

The company positions its platform around the concept of agentic process automation, distinguishing it from what it characterizes as generative AI repackaged as agentic solutions. It cites a Gartner figure suggesting that more than 90% of so-called agentic AI solutions are repackaged generative AI layered on legacy systems, with only around 130 vendors among thousands delivering genuine agent-driven orchestration. Automation Anywhere also offers a free Cloud Community Edition for users to begin automating without a paid commitment, and it maintains a global partner network for implementation support.

The held facts confirm that Automation Anywhere has an active profile on this site, with its platform categorized under Automation and Agents. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are currently held for the company.
